# P26: Module B1 — Papal States (PAP) Kingdom of God, Sanctum Imperium & 4 Papal Laws
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111
#   +1    PAP alive and owns avignon & rome
#   +10   oe_pap_kernel_yearly runs (global_var:oe_pap_ran_y set)
#   +100  oe_pap_mod_regnum_dei_permanent DB valid
#   +1000 oe_pap_mod_sanctum_imperium_permanent DB valid
oe_probe5_run_p26 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:PAP
			location:avignon = { owner ?= c:PAP }
			location:rome = { owner ?= c:PAP }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 add = 1 }
	}
	oe_pap_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pap_ran_y }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 add = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pap_mod_regnum_dei_permanent }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 add = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pap_mod_regnum_dei_permanent days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pap_mod_regnum_dei_permanent }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 add = 100 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_pap_mod_regnum_dei_permanent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pap_mod_sanctum_imperium_permanent }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 add = 1000 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pap_mod_sanctum_imperium_permanent days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pap_mod_sanctum_imperium_permanent }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p26 add = 1000 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_pap_mod_sanctum_imperium_permanent
		}
	}
}

# P27: Modules B2 & B3 — Latin Greece Frankokratia + Italian Republics S.P.Q.R. Revival
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111
#   +1    ACH/ATH/NAX/NEG/CEP/CYP/CIL alive + oe_lat_kernel_yearly runs (oe_lat_ran_y set)

#   +100  oe_lat_mod_fief_foundation DB valid (Latin Partitio Enfeoffment)

# P28: Module B4 — 4 Hanseatic Building Kontors (OHK1-4), 33-Type Lock, Burgundy/Granada/Black Sea
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111
#   +1    OHK1..OHK4 all exist with country_type = building & is_subject_type = oe_hbg_kontor
#   +10   london/bruges/bergen/novgorod remain owned by ENG/FLA/NOR/NOV (0 land detached!)
#   +100  OHK1 protected by oe_is_protected_special_subject (33-type lock!)
#   +1000 oe_hbg_kernel_yearly runs (oe_hbg_ran_y set) + oe_hbg_kontor_compliant_mod DB valid
oe_probe5_run_p28 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p28 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:OHK1 c:OHK1 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_hbg_kontor }
			country_exists = c:OHK2 c:OHK2 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_hbg_kontor }
			country_exists = c:OHK3 c:OHK3 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_hbg_kontor }
			country_exists = c:OHK4 c:OHK4 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_hbg_kontor }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p28 add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:london = { owner ?= c:ENG }
			location:bruges = { owner ?= c:FLA }
			location:bergen = { owner ?= c:NOR }
			location:novgorod = { owner ?= c:NOV }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p28 add = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { c:OHK1 ?= { oe_is_protected_special_subject = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p28 add = 100 }
	}
	oe_hbg_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_hbg_ran_y }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_hbg_kontor_compliant_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p28 add = 1000 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_hbg_kontor_compliant_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_hbg_kontor_compliant_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe5_p28 add = 1000 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_hbg_kontor_compliant_mod
		}
	}
	}
}
